relations.check: Verify backup-power readiness, fuel and the loads it can support with the facility; a source listing does not establish current availability.
Verify helipad availability and applicable operating requirements with the facility before considering air access; a listing does not establish clearance, capacity or a transport route.
Verify current receiving capability and access with the facility; the listing does not establish capacity, trauma designation or a destination ranking.
Verify access redundancy and current road conditions; the described access arrangement does not establish a closure or an evacuation route.
Obtain applicable water-level, elevation and site-exposure evidence before assessing flooding; the described boundary alone establishes no flood-zone membership or flooding likelihood.

feature_checks.airport: For the selected airport, verify runway conditions and applicable aircraft and ground-equipment operating requirements against up-to-date site reports. Station wind alone supplies no runway status, aircraft limit or response authority.
feature_checks.hospital: For the selected hospital, verify patient access and the readiness of essential services with the facility. Nearby station wind does not establish on-site conditions, service disruption or receiving capacity.
feature_checks.road: For the selected road geometry, verify conditions along the affected segments. Station wind does not establish a road closure or a usable alternative route.
feature_checks.waterway: For the selected water feature, obtain applicable gauge, datum and site-elevation evidence. Station wind does not establish a water-level impact or flooding likelihood.
